note: DRAFT ONLY: prepare matching toolchains, create Mac4 gate devices, replace REQUIRES_* values, then validate and gate the change. The Foundry gate's verifier (one-foundry tools/foundry-verify) runs these on the tree a merge would produce, read from main so a proposal cannot change its own check. Each check runs only when a changed path matches its `when`. The engine's tests need the saved crate's audio, which is on Drive (scripts/fetch-saved-crate.sh); it is kept on the T7 between runs, and a fetch that fails is exit 75: not judged, never a failed test. The app has no tests of its own, so its check is that it builds from project.yml for the simulator. tools/, e2e/ and UITests/ have no check: a change confined to them merges unchecked.
name: airdeck checks

checks.name: AirDeckKit swift test (mac5)
command: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; C=/Volumes/FoundryBuild/fleet-dd/airdeck-verify/crate-$(shasum -a 256 scripts/fetch-saved-crate.sh | cut -c1-12); mkdir -p $C App/SavedCrate && rsync -a $C/ App/SavedCrate/ && bash scripts/fetch-saved-crate.sh >&2 && rsync -a --include='*/' --include='*.mp3' --exclude='*' App/SavedCrate/ $C/ || exit 75; cd Packages/AirDeckKit && swift test --scratch-path /Volumes/FoundryBuild/fleet-dd/airdeck-verify/kit

checks.name: AirDeck app build
command: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; xcodegen generate >&2 || exit 75; xcodebuild build -project AirDeck.xcodeproj -scheme AirDeck -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath {derived_data} -skipMacroValidation CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=
